title: POSTing JSON with a deadline
hints: Build the request yourself so it carries ctx: http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, baseURL+"/users", bytes.NewReader(body)). When ctx expires, the request is cancelled.
Set req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json") and send it with client.Do(req). Close the body, and treat any status other than 201 Created as an error.
Decode {"id": ...} from the response. client.Do's error wraps ctx's error, so callers can check errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded).
